description: Format a South African legal citation per standard legal conventions. Formats: "full" -> "Section 2, Protection of Personal Information Act 4 of 2013", "short" -> "s. 2 POPIA", "pinpoint" -> "s. 2". Does NOT validate existence -- use validate_citation for that.

citation.description: Citation string to format (e.g., "Section 2, Protection of Personal Information Act 4 of 2013")

format.description: Output format. "full" (default): formal citation. "short": abbreviated. "pinpoint": section reference only.

name: format_citation
